detailed_description:
The target video is a romantic music-video style with vibrant sunset warm tones, shallow depth of field, and magical golden light particles. No wide or long shots; all compositions are medium shot, medium close-up, or tighter.
[Shot 1] A medium two-three shot frames all three women from the waist up on a white bridge at sunset. <Subject 1> wears a coral puffy-sleeve dress, her silver hair and fox ears glowing. <Subject 2> wears a sky-blue off-shoulder dress, her black ponytail over one shoulder. <Subject 3> wears a champagne-gold slip dress, her black center-parted hair flowing past her shoulders. They walk toward the camera arm in arm, smiling and laughing. The camera pulls back slightly with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping waist-up framing. Golden light particles burst around them. <Audio 1> begins playing.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to an intimate close-up of <Subject 1>. Her fluffy white fox ears and silver hair frame her face. She looks into the lens with a tender smile, her lips moving in precise lip-sync to the vocals of <Audio 1>. Glowing pink and gold particles float slowly around her ears and hair. The camera holds a static shot, then pushes in very slightly.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera transitions with a sweeping light flare to a medium shot of all three women standing in a soft-focus meadow, framed from the waist up. They raise their free hands and smile joyfully at the camera as confetti-like light particles rain down around them. The camera arcs gently around them with small amplitude at moderate speed, holding the medium framing until the end.

overall_soundscape:
Light footsteps and laughter carry over a soft evening breeze on the bridge and meadow.
